title: Goal Achievement After Utilizing an Anti-PCSK9 Antibody in Statin Intolerant Subjects-4

sections.abstract:
The primary objective of the study was to evaluate the effect of 12 weeks of subcutaneous (SC) evolocumab compared with ezetimibe, on percent change from baseline in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in hypercholesterolemic adults unable to tolerate an effective dose of a statin.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline in Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) at the Mean of Weeks 10 and 12. timeframe=Baseline and Weeks 10 and 12. Ezetimibe=-20.39 (±3.19); Evolocumab=-59.75 (±2.30). p=<0.0001
